items.title: SALT Centre Level 3 Gym – Not opened during Sep Holidays
items.author: Lek Jian Rong
items.description:
Dear Students,
Please note that the
SALT Centre Level 3 Gym will be not be opened this upcoming September school holiday (7th to 11th September)
🏋️
Gym Walk-In Sessions
The gym will reopen for student walk-in sessions
from 14 September onwards
, with the usual operating hours of
2:00pm to 4:30pm
.
📢
Teachers’ Day Closure
Please also note that the SALT Gym will
not be open on 3rd and 4th September
due to the
Teachers’ Day celebrations
.
We apologise for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your patience and understanding during this period.
Thank you once again for your cooperation, and we look forward to welcoming everyone back to the gym from
14 September!
💪
Regards,
SALT Department
